I have identified and fixed the bug in [`outputLink`](file:///C:/Users/USER/Downloads/agent-test/limit/geminifull_t6t2_r1/work/src/Tokenizer.ts#L16-L31) inside [src/Tokenizer.ts](file:///C:/Users/USER/Downloads/agent-test/limit/geminifull_t6t2_r1/work/src/Tokenizer.ts).

### Cause
When [`outputLink`](file:///C:/Users/USER/Downloads/agent-test/limit/geminifull_t6t2_r1/work/src/Tokenizer.ts#L16-L31) tokenized a link or image's inner text via [`lexer.inlineTokens(text)`](file:///C:/Users/USER/Downloads/agent-test/limit/geminifull_t6t2_r1/work/src/Tokenizer.ts#L27), it unconditionally reset `lexer.state.inLink = false` upon returning instead of restoring the previous `inLink` state. When an image (`![logo](logo.png)` or reference-style `![logo][img]`) was parsed inside an outer link, the nested [`outputLink`](file:///C:/Users/USER/Downloads/agent-test/limit/geminifull_t6t2_r1/work/src/Tokenizer.ts#L16-L31) call cleared `lexer.state.inLink` to `false` for the remainder of the outer link's inline tokens, allowing [`Tokenizer.url`](file:///C:/Users/USER/Downloads/agent-test/limit/geminifull_t6t2_r1/work/src/Tokenizer.ts#L1028-L1064) (guarded by `!this.state.inLink` in [`_Lexer`](file:///C:/Users/USER/Downloads/agent-test/limit/geminifull_t6t2_r1/work/src/Lexer.ts#L511)) to match subsequent bare GFM URLs and email addresses inside the outer link.

### Fix
Saved `const outerInLink = lexer.state.inLink;` before setting `lexer.state.inLink = true` in [`outputLink`](file:///C:/Users/USER/Downloads/agent-test/limit/geminifull_t6t2_r1/work/src/Tokenizer.ts#L22-L30) and restored `lexer.state.inLink = outerInLink;` after [`lexer.inlineTokens(text)`](file:///C:/Users/USER/Downloads/agent-test/limit/geminifull_t6t2_r1/work/src/Tokenizer.ts#L27) completes.
